assets.prompt: Two-storey Mediterranean Revival townhomes inside a gated community in Palm Beach County, Florida. Cream stucco, terracotta barrel-tile roofs, arched loggias, tall royal palms, a neatly edged lawn, one resident walking a dog far in the distance. Late-afternoon sun, long soft shadows, a pale hazy sky. Eye level from the street. Keep the lower-left third calm and slightly darker for a large headline. Documentary photograph, not a render. Shot on a full-frame camera with a 35mm lens at f/4, natural light only. True-to-life colour with a soft warm cast, gentle contrast, slightly muted greens and creamy highlights, fine film grain like Kodak Portra 400. Real-world imperfections: weathered stucco, uneven grass, small stains, utility boxes, parked cars. No HDR, no oversaturation, no glossy or plastic surfaces, no perfect symmetry, no lens flare, no text, signs, logos or watermarks.
